QUOTE: "Engine → caller, `char*` out-param (e.g. `entropic_run`, `entropic_get_identity_config`) | Caller owns it and must call `entropic_free()`" and "Engine → caller, `const char*` (e.g. `entropic_version`, `entropic_last_error`) | Static or handle-owned. Do not free. Valid until the next call on that handle"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The table states both rules: an owned `char*` is freed with `entropic_free`, and a `const char*` is handle-owned and valid only until the next call on that handle.
